dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: I mean, you're maybe only the world's second-biggest homo.
dialogue.amharic: ማለቴ፣ ምናልባት በዓለም ሁለተኛው ትልቁ ግብረ ሰዶማዊ ነህ ብቻ።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Would you shut up and help me?

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: You got... Jesus, you got crystals in here two inches, three inches long.
dialogue.amharic: ውስጡ... ኢየሱስ፣ ሁለት ኢንች፣ ሶስት ኢንች ርዝመት ያላቸው ክሪስታሎች አሉበት።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Well, actually, it's just basic chemistry...
dialogue.amharic: እንዳውቅህ፣ ይህ መሰረታዊ ኬሚስትሪ ብቻ ነው...

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: ...but thank you, Jesse. I'm glad it's acceptable.
dialogue.amharic: …ግን አመሰግናለሁ፣ ጄሲ። የሚገባ መሆኑ ደስ ብሎኛል።

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Acceptable? You're the goddamn Iron Chef.
dialogue.amharic: የሚገባ? አንተ እውነተኛው አይሮን ቼፍ ነህ!

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Every jibhead from here to Timbuktu's gonna want a taste.
dialogue.amharic: ከዚህ እስከ ቲምቡክቱ ያለ ሰው ሁሉ ሊቀምሰው ይፈልጋል።

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: No. We only sell it. We don't use it.

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Listen, you've been watching way too much Miami Vice.

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: ...I know just the guy to talk to.

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Hey, yo. Kraze, how you doing, my man?

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Hey, you got a new dog. Right on, man.
dialogue.amharic: ሄይ፣ አዲስ ውሻ አለህ። ጥሩ ነው፣ ወንድሜ።

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Yeah, I had a dog like that once, except maybe like twice as big.
dialogue.amharic: አዎ፣ እኔም አንድ ጊዜ እንደዚህ ያለ ውሻ ነበረኝ፣ ግን ሁለት እጥፍ ያህል ትልቅ ነበር።

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Now, me personally, I would train him to go straight for the nutsack.
dialogue.amharic: እኔ በራሴ ብሆን ቀጥታ ወደ ወርች እንዲሄድ አሰለጥነው ነበር።

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: Just shut your mouth and show me your money.

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Tell me that ain't the finest scante you ever laid eyes on.
dialogue.amharic: ይህ ያየኸው ምርጥ ስካንቴ አይደለም ብለህ ንገረኝ።

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Yeah. Booya! See, what'd I say?

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: It's all right? Yeah, it's all right.

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: So what? You're back in business?

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: With a vengeance. Vato loco gotta make a living.

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: You know, with your cousin gone away and all...

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Really broke me up about Emilio.

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: That dude is like my brother.

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: You okay? You talk to him?

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: Said when the feds came, you were out sticking it in some neighbour lady.
dialogue.amharic: ፌዴራሎቹ ሲመጡ አንተ በጎረቤት ሴት ላይ ጠመዝቀህ ነበር አለ።

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Hey, you know, I got lucky twice.
dialogue.amharic: ሄይ፣ ታውቃለህ፣ ሁለት ጊዜ ዕድል አግኝቻለሁ።

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: ...he thinks maybe you dimed on him.

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Whoa, whoa, hey, hey. That is bullshit.
dialogue.amharic: ዋው፣ ዋው፣ ሄይ፣ ሄይ። ያ ውሸት ነው።

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: I should kick his punk ass for even thinking that.
dialogue.amharic: ያንን ለማሰቡ እንኳ አንጀቱን ልበጥበጥ ነበረብኝ።

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: You know what? Next time you talk to Emilio...

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: ...you tell him for me, all right?

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: Why don't you tell him yourself? Made bail this morning.
dialogue.amharic: ለምን ራስህ አትነግረውም? ዛሬ ጠዋት በዋስ ወጥቷል።

dialogue.speaker: Emilio
dialogue.source_text: Go ahead, pendejo. Kick my ass.

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: Because I know your little punk ass didn't cook it.
dialogue.amharic: አንተ ቆሻሻ ልጅ ያበሰልከው አይደለም ብዬ አውቃለሁ።

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: Damn, man. What are you, some kind of nudist?
dialogue.amharic: ውይ፣ ወንድሜ። ምን ነህ፣ ራቁታኛ ነህ?

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: Yeah, that's some stone-fine tick-tick you been cooking there, ese.
dialogue.amharic: አዎ፣ በጣም ጥሩ ቲክ-ቲክ ነው ያበሰልከው፣ ኤሴ።

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: How about you come work for me?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: I'd be willing to sell it to you...

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: Out here all by yourself, huh?

dialogue.speaker: Emilio
dialogue.source_text: Hey, I know you. He was there when I got busted.
dialogue.amharic: ሄይ፣ አንተን አውቅሃለሁ። ሲይዙኝ እሱም እዚያ ነበር።

dialogue.speaker: Emilio
dialogue.source_text: I say we cap them both.

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: You really cook up that batch?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Listen to me. I'll teach you my recipe, huh?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: What do you say? You wanna cook like me?
dialogue.amharic: ምን ትላለህ? እንደ እኔ ማብሰል ትፈልጋለህ?

dialogue.speaker: Krazy-8
dialogue.source_text: Move it, homes. You got all day?

dialogue.speaker: Jesse
dialogue.source_text: Hey, what'd you do to them?

dialogue.speaker: Walter
dialogue.source_text: Red phosphorus in the presence of moisture and accelerated by heat...
dialogue.amharic: ቀይ ፎስፎረስ ከእርጥበት ጋር ሲገናኝ በሙቀት ሲጣደፍ...

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: I don't know what's been going on with you lately...
dialogue.amharic: በቅርብ ጊዜ ምን እየሆነብህ እንደሆነ አላውቅም...

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: Whatever it is, I'll tell you this.

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: I do not like it when you don't talk to me.

dialogue.speaker: Skyler
dialogue.source_text: The worst thing you can do is shut me out.
dialogue.amharic: በጣም መጥፎው ነገር ራስህን ከእኔ መዝጋትህ ነው።
